# signoz_ingestion_key (Data Source)

Fetches an ingestion key from SigNoz using its ID, including the limits attached to it.

-> The gateway returns `value` on GET requests; it is null here only if the deployment masks it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

data "signoz_ingestion_key" "existing" {
  id = "key-abc-123"
}

output "ingestion_key_value" {
  value     = data.signoz_ingestion_key.existing.value
  sensitive = true
}

output "ingestion_key_limits" {
  value = data.signoz_ingestion_key.existing.limits
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the ingestion key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the ingestion key (RFC 3339).
- `expires_at` (String) Expiration time of the ingestion key (RFC 3339); null for a key that never expires.
- `limits` (List of Object) Rate limits attached to the key. Each element carries `id`, `signal`, `config` (`day`/`second`, each optional `size`/`count`), `metric` (the server's enforcement snapshot of the config), `tags`, `key_id`, `created_at` and `updated_at`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `name` (String) Name of the ingestion key.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the ingestion key.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the ingestion key (RFC 3339).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The ingestion key value. The gateway returns it on reads; null when the deployment masks it.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace (organization) the key belongs to.
